summary: The proof is correct and complete. It validly transfers the total unmatched-mass bound from the saturated maximum matching to every maximum via equality of matching mass, proves and applies the exact interval metronoid formula with the correct sign reversal and clipping in both cap orientations, constructs a legal min(2q_z,t_z) profile whose affine selector certifies a nonempty core and hence total profile mass at most G, and combines the fiberwise loss estimate with the global unmatched bound to obtain the sharp stated constant 3/2. All stated quantifiers over maximum matchings, admissible centers, supplied circuits, affine-minorant choices, and individual caps are preserved, and the descendant-capacity conclusion uses only membership in the nonempty descendant collection, not attainment of its supremum.
